source: official GWOSC/GWTC released event catalog only
new_event_rule: physical commonName absent from historical GWTC-5.0-era clean table
coordinate: natural logarithm of source-frame M_chirp in solar masses
baseline: frozen V3 training-only Gaussian KDE with original train_ell and selected_bandwidth, NO REFIT

null.statistic: 2 sum(a cos(k ell)+b sin(k ell)-log Z)

out_of_training_support: include all eligible positive finite values; report inside/outside counts
negative_results: retain unchanged; do not retrain, rescan, or promote robustness into independent replication
manifest_lock: prepare manifest of official release and event identities, hash and commit BEFORE evaluating residuals
